name: Emberheart Breastplate
summary: A breastplate that warms you and scorches those who strike you.
description: Dwarves of the deep furnaces gift it to their best smiths. A glow shows through the seams when its wearer is angry.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. You have Resistance to Cold damage. When a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, it takes 1d6 Fire damage.
